PLAN "2-Week Travel Maintenance Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "hypertrophy maintenance during travel"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper body and core - travel block":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_dip 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower body - bodyweight and tempo":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Push-focused - volume with easier load":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          front_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          tricep_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper body maintenance + tempo":
        warmup:
          jogging 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown or tricep_dip 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          upper_back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower body focus with maintenance load":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat substitute 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pulling + core stability":
        warmup:
          lat_pulldown or pull_up variant 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45 seconds rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
          spinal_twist 60 seconds

Notes:
- All exercises use canonical names only; substitutions are limited to safe, accessible equivalents (e.g., a pull-up bar can be used for pull_up variants; bench_press can be replaced with floor press if necessary, but preferred to keep to plan).
- Reps and sets adhere to the two-dot range convention (e.g., 4x8..12).
- RPE targets are 7 to maintain stimulus without progressing load.
- If equipment or space constraints arise, you can swap bench_press/dumbbell_press with push_up as needed, keeping volume similar.
- Cardio is minimized to walking/jogging simple warmups to maintain conditioning without excessive fatigue during travel.
- All sessions assume hotel room constraints: no heavy equipment beyond door pull-up bar and a yoga mat.

PLAN "Travel Day Nutrition Guidance"
TYPE guidance
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "simple travel nutrition for hypertrophy maintenance"

PHASES
  PHASE "General guidance" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday:
        guidance:
          - "Aim for protein 1.6–2.2 g/kg body weight per day; distribute evenly across meals."
          - "Total daily calories roughly maintenance level; avoid large deficits if possible."
          - "Prioritize whole-food sources when possible: lean proteins, vegetables, fruits, whole grains."
          - "Hydration: target 2.5–3.5 liters per day, adjust for activity and climate."
          - "Protein-rich restaurant options: grilled chicken/fish, tofu, eggs; request extra vegetables."
          - "Carbs: maintain regular intake around training windows; choose rice, potatoes, quinoa, oats when available."
          - "Fats: include healthy fats (olive oil, avocado, nuts) as part of meals."
          - "Meal timing: 3–4 balanced meals with 20–40 g protein each; a post-workout protein-rich snack if feasible."
      DAY Tuesday:
        guidance:
          - "If room service is the option: choose a protein-forward plate (chicken, seafood, legumes) with vegetables; ask for less oil."
          - "Order a protein shake or Greek yogurt if available to hit protein target."
      DAY Wednesday:
        guidance:
          - "Restaurant trick: build a plate with half vegetables, a palm-sized portion of protein, and a fist-sized portion of carbohydrate."
      DAY Thursday:
        guidance:
          - "Snack strategy: keep portable proteins handy (protein bar, jerky) if traveling; pair with fruit or yogurt."
      DAY Friday:
        guidance:
          - "Indulge modestly if desired; fit the rest of the day to stay close to maintenance calories."
      DAY Saturday:
        guidance:
          - "Review restaurant menus in advance; choose grilled/steamed options, avoid fried heavy dishes."
      DAY Sunday:
        guidance:
          - "Plan ahead for next travel day; log meals if possible to stay on track."
OUTPUT_NOTES
- This is simplified, practical guidance for travel days focusing on staying close to maintenance for hypertrophy.
- Prioritize protein targets, consistent hydration, and mindful portion control when using restaurants or room service.

PLAN "Weekly Tracking Metric for Travel Hold"
TYPE guidance
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "sensible weekly metric for maintenance hold block"

PHASES
  PHASE "General guidance" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY metrics:
        guidance:
          - "Weekly metric: maintain within +/- 2–3% of starting bodyweight, averaged across the week." 
          - "Alternatively, track average daily protein intake: target 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day, see if within weekly average."
          - "Strength cue: log session RPEs and volume; aim for equal or slightly higher total sets/reps compared to baseline week (e.g., within ±10%)."
          - "Progress metric: alternate between two options each day (weight stability, or performance retention) to balance psychology."
          - "Consistency metric: complete at least 4–5 training sessions with the bodyweight plan; record any substitutions."
          - "Hydration metric: average water intake target 2.5–3.5 L/day; track daily total."
          - "Meal metric (optional): hit daily protein target and stay within calorie window ±200 kcal of maintenance."
OUTPUT_NOTES
- This metric set keeps tracking simple and clinically relevant for a hypertrophy hold during travel.
- Choose one primary metric (weight or performance) and one secondary (protein intake or hydration) to minimize friction.
